name: Viking Therapeutics, Inc.

catalysts.headline: Viking announces positive topline results from VK2735 maintenance-dosing study: 22% placebo-adjusted weight loss at week 33 (no plateau observed); patients switching from weekly to every-other-week dosing retained up to 97% of prior weight loss, and up to 90% with monthly dosing (vs ~61% retention on placebo); GI side effects during maintenance similar to placebo
catalysts.impact: Stock surged intraday; reported magnitude ranges +27% to +39% depending on source/timing (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: Truist Securities called the VK2735 maintenance readout a 'best case scenario'; Oppenheimer raised price target to $120 from $100 (Outperform)

Viking filed Form S-3ASR shelf registration enabling future capital raises to fund VK2735 subcutaneous and oral Phase 3 programs; company also completed a ~$159.6M follow-on equity raise around this period
catalysts.impact: dilutive financing event; extends balance sheet

catalysts.headline: Viking reports Q2 2026 financial results: net loss $128.1M ($1.10/share) vs $65.6M ($0.58/share) in Q2 2025; R&D expense +92.4% YoY to $115.8M; cash & short-term investments of $502M
catalysts.impact: loss beat consensus (-$1.21 est.); shares reportedly held steady post-print

conflicts: Same-day price move reported inconsistently: StocksToTrade cites close of $39.89 (+32.5%); GuruFocus cites a 'closing' price of $39.58 (+31% midday); other reports cite +30.9% premarket ($39.42), +28% mid-morning ($38.63), and a premarket peak near +39% (~$42, high of day $45.92); intraday range cited as $31.00-$45.92 with close described as '10.9% below session peak.' Not reconciled to a single figure.

Market cap conflict: one source cites $3.51B as of Sep 21, 2026 close (pre-catalyst) and separately $4.12B (undated 2026 figure), versus a calculated post-surge figure of ~$4.65B. Sources not reconciled.

Short interest cited as ~22-25% 'of float' by some trackers vs. ~19% of shares outstanding when computed directly from FINRA's 22,186,520-share short figure; the float denominator underlying the higher percentage is not independently confirmed.

Next earnings date: file carries Nov 4, 2026 (unconfirmed); separate Oct 2026 sources gave conflicting unconfirmed estimates of Oct 26, 2026 and Oct 28, 2026 for the same report -- not reconciled, no company confirmation found either way.
